text.en: Establishment of a National High School. – There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in the City of Tacloban, Province of Leyte to be known as V & G National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the V & G National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
